Founded in 2025

About KHAEELON

Kheelu Mode is a startup creating interactive, offline learning experiences for children through Lumi. The platform combines stories, lessons, questions, and quizzes that encourage children to engage actively with educational content. It also offers new content packs and seasonal sets, with school-focused learning modules planned for future releases.

Overview & Products
About Kheelona

Kheelona is a company that creates AI toys designed to support language development and learning in children. Their product, Kheelu, interacts with children through conversation, stories, and games, adapting to their learning pace and language preferences. The toy includes memory technology that tracks a child's progress and provides content, while ensuring safety and privacy by not connecting to the open internet. It is based in Bengaluru, India.
